item.title: PGConf.dev is back
item.description: PGConf.dev 2027 will be held on May 11–14 in Montreal, QC to bring users, developers, and organizers together to advance PostgreSQL development. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: revisit why Postgres 19 shipped late
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 shipped about a month after the usual September to October window for major PostgreSQL releases. The delay came from the project's focus on quality. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: AWS Lambda Doubles Its Timeout to 30 Minutes After Eight Years at 15
item.description: AWS has raised the maximum timeout of on-demand Lambda Event Functions from 15 to 30 minutes in all commercial regions, with no opt-in and no new pricing. The limit had stood since 2018. (1 source: infoq)
